profile.headline: I turn curious questions into
profile.intro: Hey, I'm Aubrey — a data scientist and AI builder trained at AIMS. I work in the space between complex data and tools that make a real difference: health signals, mobility at scale, and AI agents that serve real people.
about: I'm drawn to questions that don't have obvious answers — from listening for asthma in breathing audio to making AI feel genuinely useful for a lodge in Livingstone. I like getting hands-on, learning in public, and making complicated ideas easier to explore.

My training at the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) grounded me in statistics, machine learning, topological data analysis and big-data systems. Today I build AI agents and run practical AI trainings for teams across Zambia.

ML & data projects shipped on GitHub

projects.title: Listening for asthma
projects.description: Classifying normal vs. asthmatic breathing from raw audio — turning each recording into signal features, persistent entropy and Betti curves, then letting the models listen.

projects.title: Reading breast-tissue images
projects.description: A logistic-regression model that predicts whether a tumour is malignant or benign from features extracted from breast-tissue images — built for interpretability, not just accuracy.

projects.title: Mobility, at scale
projects.description: Processing and analysing large mobility datasets with Apache Spark — distributed transformations, aggregations and the patterns hiding in how people move.

projects.title: Intro to Neural Nets — AIMS 2025
projects.description: Hands-on neural-network labs from the AIMS 2025 course: building networks from first principles, backpropagation, optimisation and training deep models in practice.

projects.title: Real-time face recognition
projects.description: A real-time face-recognition pipeline in Python: detect faces in a live video stream, encode them, and match identities frame by frame.

projects.title: Finding signals in DNA
projects.description: Classifying DNA sequences as binding or non-binding for a transcription factor, combining a convolutional network with K-means feature exploration.

projects.title: Microarrays & digits: comparing learners
projects.description: kNN vs. classification trees on prostate-cancer DNA microarrays (n ≪ p) and kNN on MNIST — Kruskal-Wallis screening, ROC curves, 100 stochastic hold-out splits and ANOVA on test errors.

projects.title: Predicting first-year performance
projects.description: Logistic regression and discriminant analysis to predict first-year academic outcomes — and to understand which factors actually matter.

projects.title: Topological data analysis
projects.description: Persistent homology in practice — finding the shape of data with simplicial complexes, barcodes and persistence diagrams.

projects.title: Algebra & cryptography: RSA
projects.description: Implementing RSA encryption from the number theory up — modular arithmetic, key generation, encryption and decryption.
